title: Synthesis and Spectroscopic Characterization of Benzimidazole-Derived Schiff Base: Investigation of Optical Properties, DNA Binding, DFT, and Molecular Docking.
authors: Alhakimi, Ahmed N; Al-Hazmy, Sadeq M; Alhagri, Ibrahim A; Messaoudi, Sabri; Alantry, Ahmed Kaid; Alresheedi, Tahani
one_liner_zh: 该文合成苯并咪唑席夫碱并研究其光谱性质、DNA结合及分子对接，虽涉及小分子-DNA互作和对接，但对象为小分子配体而非蛋白质-DNA体系，方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: This study reports the synthesis and characterization of a novel benzimidazole-derived Schiff base (BIMPB) via the condensation of (1H-benzo[d]imidazol-2-yl)methanamine with 1-phenylbutane-1,3-dione. The structure was confirmed using (1)H-NMR, (13)C-NMR and FT-IR spectroscopy. Photophysical properties were extensively evaluated, revealing a strong S(0) --> S(2) transition at 212 nm and fluorescence emission peaks at 396 and 410 nm, corresponding to pi --> pi* and n --> pi* transitions. BIMPB demonstrated significant sensitivity to pH variations, exhibiting blue shifts of 11-23 nm across different environments. Furthermore, the compound acts as a fluorescent chemosensor for Cu(2+) and Ca(2+) ions, where coordination leads to a substantial reduction in fluorescence intensity accompanied by a distinct blue shift. The interaction between BIMPB and DNA was investigated using UV-Vis and fluorescence titration. The results showed a hypochromic effect and a minor shift in the absorption peak from 342 nm to 340 nm, suggesting a binding mechanism dominated by intercalation or electrostatic interactions. A high binding constant (K(b) = 2.1 x 10(5) M(-1)) and a fluorescence quenching efficiency of 58.9% confirm the formation of a stable complex. Stern-Volmer analysis indicated a static quenching mechanism. These experimental findings, supported by molecular docking studies (binding energy = -8.3 kcal/mol), highlight the potential of BIMPB as a sensitive molecular probe for DNA-targeting and chemical sensing applications.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过(1H-苯并[d]咪唑-2-基)甲胺与1-苯基丁烷-1,3-二酮的缩合反应，报道了一种新型苯并咪唑衍生的席夫碱（BIMPB）的合成与表征。其结构通过(1)H-NMR、(13)C-NMR和FT-IR光谱确认。光物理性质被广泛评估，揭示了在212 nm处存在强S(0) --> S(2)跃迁，以及396 nm和410 nm处的荧光发射峰，分别对应于pi --> pi*和n --> pi*跃迁。BIMPB对pH变化表现出显著敏感性，在不同环境中显示出11-23 nm的蓝移。此外，该化合物作为Cu(2+)和Ca(2+)离子的荧光化学传感器，配位导致荧光强度显著降低并伴随明显蓝移。利用UV-Vis和荧光滴定法研究了BIMPB与DNA之间的相互作用。结果显示减色效应和吸收峰从342 nm到340 nm的微小移动，表明结合机制以嵌入或静电相互作用为主。高结合常数（K(b) = 2.1 x 10(5) M(-1)）和58.9%的荧光猝灭效率证实了稳定复合物的形成。Stern-Volmer分析表明存在静态猝灭机制。这些实验发现，辅以分子对接研究（结合能 = -8.3 kcal/mol），突显了BIMPB作为靶向DNA和化学传感应用的敏感分子探针的潜力。
